assumptions.sizing: fixed margin = starting capital every trade (3x notional), NO compounding, one position per coin; equity = 1 + sum of per-trade returns on margin
assumptions.entry: open of the bar after the signal
assumptions.path: 1h candles when available (else the signal timeframe); stop assumed first if stop and target share a candle
assumptions.events: transitions into a condition; forward returns close-to-close; t-stat ignores overlap (optimistic)

weights.method: Information coefficient (Pearson corr.) of each score component with the 24h forward return, per coin and timeframe; in-sample = first 70% of each series, out-of-sample = last 30%. Proposed weight ∝ max(0, in-sample mean IC).
weights.solid_rule: a non-equal weighting must reach out-of-sample mean IC >= 0.02 AND be positive in >= 70% of coin/timeframe series

multiple_testing.note: With this many tests, ~2.3% per side would clear |t|>=2 by luck alone; overlapping forward windows make t-stats optimistic.
